deploy.startCommand: PYTHONPATH=.. sh -c 'python -m celery -A worker.main.celery_app beat -l info --schedule /tmp/celerybeat-schedule --pidfile /tmp/celerybeat.pid >> /tmp/celerybeat.log 2>&1 & BEAT_PID=$!; trap "kill $BEAT_PID 2>/dev/null; wait $BEAT_PID 2>/dev/null" TERM INT; exec python -m celery -A worker.main.celery_app worker -l info --concurrency=4'
